entities.summary: Victor Georg Hansen was a Danish jurist, entomologist and tennis player. As an entomologist, he specialized in the beetles and is best known for his contributions to the beetle volumes of the Danmarks Fauna series. He competed in two events at the 1912 Summer Olympics.
